segments.title: A 2,000-year-old computer
segments.say: Divers found a computer that's two thousand years old.

segments.title: Found in a shipwreck
segments.say: In 1901, sponge divers found it in a Roman-era shipwreck off Greece.

segments.title: Bronze gears inside
segments.say: Inside the corroded block: dozens of tiny bronze gears.

segments.title: It predicted eclipses
segments.say: It modeled the Sun, Moon and planets, and could predict eclipses.

segments.title: Who built it? Unknown
segments.say: Who built it is still not confirmed. It's in a museum in Athens.
